question: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immediately after two consecutive visits to the '/detail' page, and how many times does each third-page visit occur?
sql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, option, 
    CASE WHEN path = '' THEN NULL ELSE path END AS path,
    CASE WHEN path = '' THEN NULL ELSE rtrim(path, '/') END AS norm_path
  FROM activity_log
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT session, stamp, option, path, norm_path,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) AS rn
  FROM normalized
),
consecutive_detail AS (
  SELECT r1.session, r1.rn, r1.path AS path1, r2.path AS path2, r3.path AS path3, r3.norm_path AS norm_path3
  FROM ranked r1
  JOIN ranked r2 ON r1.session = r2.session AND r2.rn = r1.rn + 1
  JOIN ranked r3 ON r1.session = r3.session AND r3.rn = r1.rn + 2
  WHERE r1.norm_path = '/detail' AND r2.norm_path = '/detail'
  AND r3.norm_path IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT norm_path3 AS third_page, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM consecutive_detail GROUP BY norm_path3 ORDER BY cnt DESC, third_page
